meta.question: Does forecast wind at 850 hPa warn of a fast run earlier or more reliably than the surface-gust rule?
meta.run_hour: issue hour with 5 h reach > 3.75 km

rules.G: forecast gust >= 20 m/s at two consecutive hourly valid times in the next 8 h (max of 4 lattice points)
rules.G-obs: KMA ASOS gust >= 20 m/s in the hour ending at the issue hour, station within 50 km (KFS_01 only, PARTIAL)
rules.A-cal: forecast 850 hPa wind, 8 h window maximum > 15.20023 m/s (California calibration, kcf-abstain tau)
rules.A-match: secondary: 850 hPa threshold with the same number of burden point-days as G

meta.forecast: issued GFS 0.25 deg, cycles 00/06/12/18 UTC, assumed available 5 h after the cycle, valid hours t+1..t+8
meta.labels: MEASURED = computed here or reused from a committed file; ASSUMED = input, proxy or simplification; PARTIAL = G-obs on four stations for one fire; COARSE = S5; NOT RUN = not computed
